review.verdict: Passes: the core joke (robot's taller diagnosis bar vs. the worried human doctor's shorter one) reads instantly with correct human/robot casting, but the background datacenter-and-drought vignette is too small and ambiguous to land, and a stray line visibly wires the window to the robot's chest like a rendering bug.
revisionNotes: Remove the stray vertical line running from the window pane down into the robot's chest dot — it reads as a rendering glitch linking the two, not an intended prop.
Anchor the window-back/window-frame group lower and larger (e.g. scale 1.15, at y:0.2) so it sits flush against the characters instead of floating with a big gap above their heads.

The tree stumps and dry well in the window read as unlabeled dots and a stick at this scale — enlarge the stumps and give the well a visible rim/circle so the drought half of the joke survives a phone-size glance.
Give the well its own distinct shape separate from the protest flag (e.g. a ring plus a crossbar) so it doesn't collapse into 'flag on a hill'.

Minor: the human's orange shirt matches the taller (robot-side) bar's color — swap the chart's bar colors or the human's shirt tone so the color coding doesn't momentarily point the wrong way before pose/position clarifies it.
